data.name: Lateefah
data.gender_notes: Lateefah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Originated from the Arabic word 'lateef' which means 'gentle' or 'tender'. It is a name given to a child who is expected to be delicate, tender, and kind in her actions towards others. The name Lateefah carries the meaning “Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lateefah usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle nature of Allah towards His creation.
data.etymology: Lateefah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lateefah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
